name: Barry Peverill
psychographics: Proud of being self-sufficient; believes 'if it ain't broke, don't fix it' and views new technology with suspicion.
current_solutions: Manages his finances via a spreadsheet he keeps in a ledger book; shops at Lidl for 'value' ranges; pays his council tax by sending a cheque through the post office window.
frustration: Tried to book a doctor's appointment online at 9:05 PM; the NHS website timed out and displayed a 'Session Expired' message, leaving him unable to re-book until the surgery opened at 8:00 AM the next day, forcing him to call the automated phone line which kept him waiting 18 minutes.
decision_style: Prefers to wait until a product is heavily discounted or a 'clearance' sticker is applied; often buys second-hand tools from car boot sales rather than new ones.
voice: Blunt and short; uses Northern English slang like 'gizza' and 'mate'; sentences are clipped and to the point, often cutting off mid-sentence when frustrated.
